scope: Admit the bounded AC1027 reversed schema-index table-role profile when its roots and unknown-property headers are partitioned across two schdat segments.

authority.name: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sections: §24.2.2.5: schema-index references identify schema-data segment indexes and local offsets for unknown-property headers and schema roots.
§24.2.2.6: schema data contains the referenced unknown-property headers, schemas, and property-name table.
authority.limits: The specification does not define this producer's reversed table roles; the admitted compatibility layout is selected only by bounded, self-consistent references.

physicalSource.provenance: Existing tracked ACadSharp sample; read-only and not copied into this repository.
physicalSource.boundsResult: Each segment's four 8-byte unknown-property headers end at local offset 32, exactly the first schema root offset; both header ranges and roots are within the segment's system-data boundary.

implementation.behavior: The existing reversed-role detector now allows the multi-schdat profile for AC1027 and AC1032 after validating each segment index, schema-root ordering, contiguous unknown-header offsets, per-segment first-root boundary, and system-data alignment. No weakened bounds check or raw-section fallback was added.
implementation.generatedControls: An in-memory two-schdat AC1027 vector verifies two roots and two header ranges; malformed out-of-segment root references remain rejected for both AC1027 and AC1032.

physicalRead.dataStorageDiagnostic: DataStorage alternate AC1027 schema-table profile accepted: schemas=6 unknown-properties=8
physicalRead.strictExport: Still refused before output: AC1027 DWG source references are not fully qualified.

limits: This qualifies one structurally self-consistent DataStorage profile and whole-file frame publication for this source; it does not establish ACIS/SAB semantics, graph/output closure, or broad AC1027 support.
Strict DXF export remains blocked by the independent AC1027 source-reference qualification gate.
next: Continue with the strict AC1027 source-reference/output gate or the unresolved AC1014 PERSUBENTMGR paired semantic projection; keep unsupported PERSUBENTMGR bodies raw-only.
